episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Taesan and the angels live in disguise among humans. Samin discovers Ogwi, who has been sealed away.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While Tae-san is haunted by his past guilt, Sa-min seeks O-gwi's help to steal Mirr's power. An odd light signals the evil's return.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After evil spirits strike, Tae-san worries for the injured angels. O-gwi, with the soul stone, vows revenge as Ma-rok secretly hunts Sa-min.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Ma-rok warns Tae-san of O-gwi and Sa-min's return. As they sense the evil at their gathering, Geum-soon, the only human Tae-san cares for, becomes a target.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Tae-san protects the angels and Geum-soon, while Sa-min kidnaps Mirr. O-gwi takes the power of Mirr and the soul stone. Ma-rok unleashes his wand's power.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: O-gwi battles Sa-min for the soul stone and escapes with Mirr. Tae-san opens the Hellmouth, restoring the angels' powers but unleashing evil worldwide.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Ogwi prayed to God, but a different entity answers him. To stop Samin from stealing Mirr's dragon soul, Taesan storms an underground temple in fury.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: As angels clash with Samin's fallen angels, Taesan falls defending Mirr, only to rise again to seal away the evil and save the angels.
